colors.dark_mode_alternative: Avoid dark mode to keep editorial feel, but if needed: bg #0A0A0A, text #FDFDFD

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Massive negative space, strict alignment, no arbitrary centering.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: The Tetris Grid) - Asymmetry, visual tension.
spacing_and_layout.borders: No rounded corners (`rounded-none`). Crisp, hard edges.

navigation.style: Glassmorphism (Crystal variant) ONLY if sticky, otherwise Solid transparent.
navigation.links: Minimalist text links. Hover state: underline or slight opacity change. Include ES/EN toggle.

hero.layout: Large Vimeo player (aspect-video) centered or full width, Name & Title placed with huge typography below or overlapping.

project_card.text: Title in medium weight, director/category in small muted text below.

buttons.classes: border border-black px-6 py-3 text-sm tracking-widest uppercase hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors rounded-none

footer.style: Massive space, huge typography for contact.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Images scale up slightly on hover. Text links underline or fade.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Staggered fade up for grid items.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Ensure focus states use `focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:outline-none`.

image_urls.description: Two men looking forward, moody lighting.
Group of people looking at monitor.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use a highly structured, minimalistic editorial layout. Avoid decorative UI.
Implement the UI in pure HTML/Tailwind, do not overuse Shadcn components for marketing layouts unless for interactive logic.
Default language is Spanish with an English toggle. Create a JSON structure to handle translations.
Include a hidden `/admin` route for editing the JSON content (Projects, About text).
Implement the 4 categories (Fiction, Documentaries, Commercials, Music Videos) as filterable or separate sections on the Selected Works page.
Project Detail Page: Massive hero image/video, minimal text, a clean grid for stills, optional BTS section, and an external link button.
Footer/Contact: ddfilming@gmail.com, Instagram, Vimeo, LinkedIn, IMDb.
All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (kebab-case, role-based).
